Note any changes on the main lifts. Tap Show pictures or Show description on a move to see how it's done.
How to run it
One round: do each exercise once, in order, and you're done. Rest as you need between them.
Main Circuit
Box squat – goblet
2 sets8-10 repsAny kit/Box10kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand in front of a box at about parallel height holding a weight at the chest, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down to lightly touch the box, then drive up through the heels to stand tall, keeping the weight at the chest.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes and the heels down. Touch the box under control rather than dropping, and keep the chest up and the weight close throughout.

Push press – DB
2 sets8-10 repsDB2 x 7kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at the shoulders, palms facing in, feet hip-width, ribs down, core and glutes braced.

Movement: Dip slightly at the knees, then drive up through the legs to help press the dumbbells overhead, then lower under control.

Focus: Use a short controlled leg dip and drive, keeping the ribs down and not arching the back on the press. Keep the knees in line with the middle toes, press both dumbbells evenly, and control the lower to the shoulders.

Calf raises – single leg, loaded
2 sets8-10 each sideKB/Step5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand on one foot, the ball of the foot on a step edge, a weight in the hand, holding a support with the other.

Movement: Rise up onto the toes as high as you comfortably can, then lower the heel slowly under control.

Focus: Rise and lower slowly and evenly, not bouncing, through the full comfortable range. Keep the ankle tracking straight, not rolling out, and control the lower.

Single leg deadlift – hold
2 sets20s each sideDB5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand on one leg, a soft bend in the knee, holding a weight in front of the thigh, the other leg ready to trail behind.

Movement: Hinge at the hip and lower the weight down the standing leg while the free leg lifts behind, reach a flat-backed stretch, then hold that bottom position still.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hips level, don't let the raised hip open out. Hold steady through the hips and standing glute, and keep the weight close to the leg.

Side plank – with leg raise
2 sets10 repsBodyweightBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Set up in a side plank, body straight, shoulder over the elbow, feet stacked.

Movement: Lift the top leg a short way and hold both the plank and the raised leg still for the set time.

Focus: Keep the hips lifted and level as the leg raises, resisting any sag or roll. Keep the shoulder stacked and the body in one line, and lower out if the hips drop.

Nordic hamstring curl
2 sets8-10 repsMat/AnchorBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Kneel tall on a mat with your ankles held firmly under something heavy and padded, or by a partner. Keep your body straight from knees to head, hands ready in front of your chest.

Movement: Lean forward slowly from the knees, keeping your body straight, and lower as far as you can control. Catch yourself with your hands, push back up to the start, and repeat.

Focus: Keep your hips forward and your body in one straight line, not folding at the hips. Lower as slowly as you can and only as far as you can control, and stop if you feel cramp or a sharp pull.

w/c 23 Nov 2026 · Hinge & Pull & Carry
Note any changes on the main lifts. Tap Show pictures or Show description on a move to see how it's done.
How to run it
One round: do each exercise once, in order, and you're done. Rest as you need between them.
Main Circuit
Pull-through – band
2 sets8-10 repsBandBlack band
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand facing away from a low band, the band between the legs held in both hands, hinged forward with a flat back, core braced.

Movement: Drive the hips forward to stand tall, pulling the band through, squeezing the glutes, then hinge back under control.

Focus: Drive the movement from the hips and glutes, not the arms or lower back, keeping the back flat. Stand tall with the ribs down at the top, and control the hinge back.

Row – bent-over
3 sets8-10 repsAny kit2 x7kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Feet hip-width, a weight in each hand. Push the hips back and hinge until the chest is well forward, back flat, arms hanging below the shoulders.

Movement: Pull the weight towards the lower ribs, driving the elbows back, then lower under control without standing up.

Focus: Hold the hinge still for the whole set, back flat, no bobbing up to help the lift. Squeeze the shoulder blades at the top and keep the neck long.

Suitcase carry
3 sets30mAny kit12kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall with a weight in one hand at the side like a suitcase, feet hip-width, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the torso upright and level.

Focus: Resist the pull towards the weighted side, keeping the shoulders and hips level and the ribs down. Take steady steps, brace hard, and don't let the weight swing.

Squat – hold, single leg
2 sets20s each sideBodyweightBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand on one leg, torso tall, the other foot lightly off the floor, near a support.

Movement: Bend the standing knee to lower into a partial single-leg squat and hold the position for the set time.

Focus: Keep the standing knee tracking over the foot, not caving in, and the hips level. Hold tall through the torso, breathe, and use light support as needed.

Knee drive – weighted
2 sets8-10 each sideAny kit3kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall holding a med ball, one leg ready to drive the knee up, torso tall, core braced.

Movement: Drive the knee up powerfully towards the chest while bringing the ball down to meet it, then return under control.

Focus: Stay tall and drive from the hip, keeping the standing knee soft and the hips level. Control the return, and keep the movement powerful but balanced.

V-sit ups
3 sets10 repsBodyweightBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie on your back, legs straight, arms overhead, ribs down.

Movement: Lift the torso and legs together to meet in a V, reaching towards the feet, then lower under control.

Focus: Lift from the core and keep the neck neutral, not straining the head forward. Lower under control without the back arching, and reduce the range if the back complains.

Hand plank – lateral walk
3 sets8-10 repsMatBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Start in a hand plank with the hands under the shoulders and the body in a straight line.

Movement: Walk the hands and feet sideways together a few steps one way, then back the other way, holding the plank throughout.

Focus: Keep the hips level and still as you move, with no rocking side to side. Strong core, straight back.

Overhead squat – single arm
How to
2 x 8-10 each side~3kg

Start: Hold a weight locked out overhead in one hand, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out, core braced, other arm out for balance.

Movement: Sit the hips down keeping the weight stacked overhead and the arm locked, to a comfortable depth, then drive up to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the weight over the mid-foot with a locked active arm, the chest up, and the knees in line with the middle toes. Keep the hips and shoulders level, and reduce depth if the torso tips or the arm drifts.

Ankle eversion – band
How to
3 x 8-10Light

Start: Sit with the legs out straight, a loop band round both feet, or one end round the outside of the working foot with the other end fixed to the inside.

Movement: Turn the foot outward against the band, pause, then return slowly. Finish the set, then change feet.

Focus: Move only at the ankle, with the knee and leg staying still. Turn the sole out against the band slowly and lower back with the same control.

Lateral walks – band, squat depth
How to
2 x 8-10Light

Start: Put a loop band just above the knees or round the ankles, feet hip-width, and sit down into a quarter squat with the chest up.

Movement: Step sideways with the lead foot, then follow with the other foot without letting the band go slack. Take the set number of steps one way, then come back the other way.

Focus: Stay at the same height the whole way, with the knees pressing out over the middle toes and the feet pointing forward. Keep the steps small and the band tight.

Single leg deadlift – weighted
How to
2 x 8-10 each side~6kg

Start: Stand on one leg holding a weight, the other leg ready to travel back, torso tall, standing knee soft.

Movement: Hinge forward from the hip, letting the free leg travel back as the weight lowers, then return to standing.

Focus: Hinge from the hip with a flat back, not rounding, and keep the hips level, not opening out. Keep the standing knee soft, move slowly, and control the return.

Push-up – band
How to
3 x 8-10Light

Start: Loop a band across the upper back and under the hands, set up in a push-up position, body in a straight line, core braced.

Movement: Lower the chest towards the floor, then press back up against the band's resistance, keeping the line.

Focus: Keep the body straight, not sagging at the hips. Keep the elbows tucked and the shoulders down, and control the press against the added band tension.

Straight leg raises
How to
2 x 8-10Bodyweight

Start: Lie on your back, legs straight, hands under the lower back or by the sides, ribs down.

Movement: Raise both straight legs towards the ceiling, then lower them slowly without letting the lower back arch.

Focus: Keep the lower back gently pressed down throughout, and stop lowering the moment it wants to arch. Move slowly, and bend the knees a little if the back lifts.

Swings – KB
How to
2 x 8-1012kg

Start: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor in front, feet hip-width, hinged with a flat back, core braced.

Movement: Hike the kettlebell back between the legs, then drive the hips forward to swing it up to about chest height, letting it swing back down into the next hinge.

Focus: Power the swing from a sharp hip drive, not the arms or lower back, keeping the back flat throughout. Snap the glutes at the top with the ribs down, and let the arms just guide the bell.

Gorilla row
How to
2 x 8-10 each side2 x 7kg

Start: Feet wide, a weight on the floor under each shoulder. Hinge over with a flat back and take hold of both, knees soft.

Movement: Row one weight up to the ribs while the other hand pushes down into its weight to hold you steady. Lower it, then row the other side. Keep alternating.

Focus: Both hands stay loaded the whole time, which is what makes it steadier than a single arm row. Hips and shoulders square, no twisting to get the weight up, back flat.

Suitcase march
How to
2 x 8-10 each side12kg

Start: Stand tall with your feet hip-width, holding a weight in one hand by your side, shoulders level and core braced.

Movement: March on the spot, lifting one knee to hip height at a time with a brief pause at the top. Finish the set, then change hands.

Focus: Stay tall and level as each foot leaves the floor, not leaning away from the weight or swaying side to side. Lift the knee slowly and place the foot down quietly.

Windmill
How to
2 x 8-10 each side2kg

Start: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips and both turned about 45 degrees away from the side holding the weight. Press the weight overhead with a straight arm and look up at it.

Movement: Push your hips back towards the weight side and slide your free hand down the inside of your front leg as your body tips, keeping the top arm straight up. Go as far as you can keep the arm upright, then stand tall again. Finish the set, then change sides.

Focus: Keep your eyes on the weight and the top arm straight up the whole time. Hinge from the hips with a long, straight back, not bending sideways through the spine, and only go as low as your shoulder and hamstrings allow.

Single leg deadlift – with rotation
How to
2 x 8-10 each sideModerate

Start: Stand on one leg holding a weight, soft standing knee, the other leg ready to reach behind, core braced.

Movement: Hinge at the hip and lower the weight while adding a small controlled rotation of the torso, then return to standing tall and square.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hips level, and let the rotation come from the upper body, small and controlled. Move slowly, balance and control matter more than depth.

Glute bridge – march
How to
2 x 10 each sideBodyweight

Start: Hold a bridge at the top with the hips fully extended and level, feet hip-width, core braced.

Movement: Without letting the hips drop, lift one foot a few centimetres off the floor, set it down, then the other, in a slow march.

Focus: Keep the hips absolutely still and level, no rocking or dipping as the foot lifts. The glutes and core hold the position throughout.

Sit-up pass
How to
3 x 107kg

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a med ball, ready to sit up, ribs down.

Movement: Sit up and pass or place the ball forward, then lower under control and repeat.

Focus: Curl up from the abdominals and keep the neck neutral, not throwing the head. Control the sit-up and the lower, and keep the movement smooth.

Goblet squat
How to
3 x 8-127kg

Start: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest with both hands, elbows tucked down, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down into a squat, keeping the weight at the chest and the torso upright, then drive up through the heels to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes, never caving in, and the heels flat. Keep the chest up and the weight close, and squat only as deep as you can control comfortably.

Romanian deadlift
How to
2 x 8-108kg

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, holding a weight in front of your thighs, or hands empty, with a soft bend in the knees. Set the shoulders back and brace the core.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the weight down the front of your legs, keeping it close, until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings. Drive the hips forward to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the back flat throughout, never let it round. The movement is a hip hinge, not a squat, and the weight stays close to your legs. Only go as low as you can keep the back flat.

Chest press – band, standing
How to
3 x 8-12Black band

Start: Anchor a band behind you, a handle in each hand at chest height, staggered stance, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Press the hands forward until the arms are nearly straight, then return under control to the chest.

Focus: Keep the shoulder blades set and the ribs down, not arching to press. Keep the elbows a little below shoulder height, and control the band on the return.

Balance – single leg with arm reach
How to
3 x 30s each sideBodyweight

Start: Stand on one leg, torso tall, other foot lifted, arms ready to reach.

Movement: Reach the arms (and torso if set) out to the sides or forward, challenging balance, then return to centre.

Focus: Keep the hips level and the standing knee soft as you reach, moving slowly. Fix the eyes on a point, keep the core engaged, and return under control.

Glute bridge – march
How to
2 x 8 each sideBodyweight

Start: Hold a bridge at the top with the hips fully extended and level, feet hip-width, core braced.

Movement: Without letting the hips drop, lift one foot a few centimetres off the floor, set it down, then the other, in a slow march.

Focus: Keep the hips absolutely still and level, no rocking or dipping as the foot lifts. The glutes and core hold the position throughout.

Dead bug – arms and legs
How to
3 x 8-10 each sideBodyweight

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent over the hips, arms towards the ceiling, lower back pressed gently into the floor.

Movement: Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly towards the floor, keeping the back flat, then return and swap sides.

Focus: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor as the limbs extend, never letting it arch. Move slowly and controlled, and shorten the reach if the back lifts.

Good mornings – hugged
How to
2 x 8-107kg

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, knees soft, hugging a weight to your chest with both arms, core braced.

Movement: Push the hips back and hinge forward with a flat back until the hamstrings load, then drive the hips forward to stand tall.

Focus: The weight sits high on the chest, so the back works hard to stay flat. Hinge at the hips, not the waist, and only go as far as that flat back allows.

Single arm row
How to
3 x 8-12 each side10kg

Start: Hand and knee on a bench, the other foot planted, a weight in the free hand hanging down, back flat and level.

Movement: Pull the weight towards the hip, driving the elbow back and up, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbow and squeeze the shoulder blade, keeping the back flat and level, not twisting to lift. Keep the shoulder down, and control the lower.

Single arm overhead press – band
How to
3 x 8-12 each sideRed band

Start: Stand on a band, feet hip-width, one hand at the shoulder holding the band, ribs down, core braced against the offset pull.

Movement: Press the one hand overhead against the band until the arm is straight, then lower back to the shoulder under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and resist leaning away from the working arm, staying upright. Keep the shoulder down away from the ear, and control the band on the way down.

Bird-dog – weighted arm
How to
2 x 6 each side2kg

Start: On all fours, a light weight in one hand or a cuff on the wrist, back flat and neutral, core braced.

Movement: Reach the weighted arm and the opposite leg out level with the body, hold briefly, then return and repeat, swapping as set.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square and the back flat, resisting the twist the added weight encourages. Move slowly, and keep the reach to where the neutral spine holds.

2 x 8 each5kg

Start: Half kneel, one knee down and one foot forward, a weight at the shoulder, hips tall, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Press the weight overhead until the arm is straight, then lower back to the shoulder under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the hips tall so the lower back doesn't arch. Keep the shoulder down away from the ear, and keep the torso square and steady in the half-kneel.

Suitcase carry
How to
3 x 30s each12kg

Start: Stand tall with a weight in one hand at the side like a suitcase, feet hip-width, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the torso upright and level.

Focus: Resist the pull towards the weighted side, keeping the shoulders and hips level and the ribs down. Take steady steps, brace hard, and don't let the weight swing.

Balance – single leg with arm reach
How to
3 x 8 eachBodyweight

Start: Stand on one leg, torso tall, other foot lifted, arms ready to reach.

Movement: Reach the arms (and torso if set) out to the sides or forward, challenging balance, then return to centre.

Focus: Keep the hips level and the standing knee soft as you reach, moving slowly. Fix the eyes on a point, keep the core engaged, and return under control.

Band monster walk – diagonal
How to
3 x 10 each wayLight

Start: Stand with a band around the legs, feet hip-width, knees softly bent, slight squat, torso tall.

Movement: Step diagonally forward and outward alternately, keeping tension on the band, for the set steps.

Focus: Keep tension on the band and the knees driving out, not caving. Stay low and controlled, and feel the outer hips working each step.

Side plank – with row
How to
3 x 8 eachLight

Start: Hold a side plank near a low cable or band, the top hand holding the handle, body in a straight line.

Movement: Row the handle towards your side while holding the plank, then return the arm under control.

Focus: Keep the hips lifted and level and the body in line while you row, resisting any drop or twist. Keep the shoulder stacked, and let the back do the row rather than rolling the torso.

Romanian deadlift
How to
3 x 1012kg

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, holding the weight in front of your thighs with a soft bend in the knees. Set the shoulders back and brace the core.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the weight down the front of your legs, keeping it close, until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings. Drive the hips forward to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the back flat throughout, never let it round. The movement is a hip hinge, not a squat, and the weight stays close to your legs. Only go as low as you can keep the back flat.

Waiter carry – single arm
How to
3 x 30s eachModerate

Start: Stand tall holding a weight overhead in one hand, arm straight, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the weight stable overhead.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and don't arch the lower back to hold the weight up, staying tall. Keep the shoulder stable and the arm straight, and resist tipping to either side.

Balance – single leg eyes closed
How to
3 x 20s eachBodyweight

Start: Stand on one leg near a support, torso tall, other foot lifted, then close the eyes.

Movement: Hold the single-leg balance with the eyes closed for the set time, then swap.

Focus: Keep the hips level and the standing knee soft, making constant small ankle adjustments without sight. Keep the core engaged, breathe, and keep support within reach.

Terminal knee extension
How to
3 x 15 eachLight

Start: Stand with a band around the back of one knee anchored in front, a slight bend in that knee, holding a support.

Movement: Straighten the knee fully against the band, squeezing the thigh, then let it bend slightly under control.

Focus: Focus on fully straightening the knee and squeezing the front of the thigh hard at the top. Keep it slow and controlled, stay tall, and keep the movement pain-free.

Band pull-apart – overhead
How to
3 x 12Light

Start: Hold a band overhead with straight arms, hands wider than shoulders, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Pull the band apart overhead until the arms open wide, then return under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and don't arch the lower back as the arms work overhead. Keep the shoulders down, open only to a comfortable range, and control the return.

Band row – seated on floor
How to
3 x 12Light

Start: Sit on the floor, legs straight out, band looped around the feet, sitting tall from the hips, chest up.

Movement: Pull the band towards your lower abdomen, driving the elbows back, then return under control.

Focus: Drive the elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades, not just bending the arms. Keep sitting tall with no rocking, and keep the shoulders down away from the ears.

Bird-dog – hold and pulse
How to
3 x 8 eachBodyweight

Start: On all fours, back flat and neutral, core braced, ready to extend the opposite arm and leg.

Movement: Reach the opposite arm and leg out level with the body, then pulse them through a small range while holding the position, before swapping.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square and the back flat through every pulse, resisting the twist. Keep the pulses small and controlled, and stop if the back starts to sag or rotate.

Single-leg deadlift – DB with rotation
How to
3 x 8 each5kg

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hips level, and let the rotation come from the upper body, small and controlled. Move slowly, balance and control matter more than depth.

Single arm row – band
How to
3 x 10 eachRed band

Start: Loop a band round both feet or anchor it low in front, split stance, one end in the working hand, back flat and chest up.

Movement: Pull the band towards the hip, driving the elbow back and up, then return slowly under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbow and squeeze the shoulder blade, keeping the back flat and not twisting to lift. Keep the shoulder down, and control the return.

Hip abduction – standing band
How to
3 x 12 eachRed

Start: Stand with a band around the ankles or lower legs, holding a support, torso tall.

Movement: Take the working leg out to the side against the band, keeping it straight, then return under control.

Focus: Keep the leg straight and the torso tall, not leaning to lift, and the hips level. Lead with the heel, keep it slow, and feel the outer hip.

Pallof press – standing lunge
How to
3 x 8 each5kg

Start: Stand side-on to a cable or band at chest height in a split stance, one foot forward in a shallow lunge, hands at the chest, core braced.

Movement: Press the handle straight out in front of you, resisting the pull that wants to twist you, hold briefly, then draw it back.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square over the split stance, letting nothing rotate you towards the cable. The lunge stance narrows your base, so the anti-rotation job gets harder. Keep the ribs down and press smoothly.

Calf raises – single leg
How to
3 x 12 eachBodyweight

Start: Stand on one foot, the ball of the foot on the floor or a step edge, holding a support for balance.

Movement: Rise up onto the toes as high as you comfortably can, then lower the heel slowly under control.

Focus: Rise and lower slowly and evenly, not bouncing, through the full comfortable range. Keep the ankle tracking straight, not rolling out, and control the lower.

Push-up plus – floor
How to
3 x 10Bodyweight

Start: Set up in a push-up position, hands under the shoulders, body in a straight line, core braced.

Movement: Perform a push-up, and at the top push a little further to spread the shoulder blades (the plus), then relax and repeat.

Focus: Keep the body in a straight line, not sagging or piking. Keep the elbows tucked to about 45 degrees, and on the plus spread the shoulder blades rather than shrugging.

Elbow plank – leg lift
How to
3 x 20s eachBodyweight

Start: Set up in a forearm plank, straight line from head to heels, core braced.

Movement: Keeping the hips level, lift one foot a few centimetres off the floor, hold briefly, lower, then the other.

Focus: Keep the hips level and square as the leg lifts, no rotating or sagging. Keep the ribs down and the core braced, and keep the lift small so the back stays neutral.

Balance – single leg knee drive
How to
3 x 8 each5kg

Movement: Drive the free knee up towards hip height, hold the balance briefly, then lower under control and repeat.

Focus: Keep the hips level and the standing knee soft, staying tall as the knee drives up. Fix the eyes on a point, control the drive and lower, and keep the core engaged.

3 x 15 eachBodyweight

· Red band

3 x 10Moderate

Reverse lunge to knee raise
How to

DB floor press – single arm
How to
· 7kg

Movement: Press the dumbbell up until the arm is nearly straight, then lower under control until the upper arm rests back on the floor.

Focus: Let the elbow touch the floor gently each rep rather than crashing down, and keep the shoulder blade set. Because it is one side at a time, brace the trunk so it does not twist toward the working arm.

Movement: Raise the top leg up to the side, keeping it straight and in line with the body, then lower under control.

V-sit ups

Movement: Lift the torso and legs together to meet in a V, reaching towards the feet, then lower under control.

Focus: Lift from the core and keep the neck neutral, not straining the head forward. Lower under control without the back arching, and reduce the range if the back complains.

Tricep overhead – band

· Red band

Movement: Straighten the arms to press the hands overhead against the band, then lower slowly behind the head, keeping the elbows still and pointing up.
